split_policy: Official mini_train only; hash scene names into six train/two dev scenes. Official mini_val and its previous fixed64 screen stay held out.
loss: Per-image mean Huber on conservative sparse camera-Z LiDAR points, then equal mean over images; raw metres, no scale fitting
feature_cache: Frozen backbone/neck features cached locally once; decoder-only training
checkpoint_selection: Lowest dev macro-image MAE across conservative 2-80m points; never test/mini_val
